claims.content: To provide Non-C2 JUs with situational awareness and early warning information by receiving remote surveillance track and point data available in J3 series messages and situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

goal.raw_text: To provide Non-C2 JUs with situational awareness and early warning information by receiving remote surveillance track and point data available in J3 series messages and situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

claims.content: Non-C2 JU
Surveillance information is exchanged on the Link 16 network using fixed format messages.
C<sup>2</sup> JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages transmit surveillance information in Network PGs.
The NonC<sup>2</sup> JU monitors the Surveillance NPG and is prohibited from transmitting on this NPG.
The J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages are available for monitoring by nonC<sup>2</sup> JUs for situational awareness and early warning information.
Remote surveillance track and point data are available in the J3 series messages to provide nonC<sup>2</sup> JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
A Non-C2 JU monitoring the Surveillance NPG receives situational awareness information, including remote surveillance track and point data available in J3 series messages.

trigger.raw_text: A Non-C2 JU monitoring the Surveillance NPG receives situational awareness information, including remote surveillance track and point data available in J3 series messages.

claims.content: NonC2 JU monitors the Surveillance NPG to support its mission.
NonC2 JU receives situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.

NonC2 JU monitors the J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages, which are used to report Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data, for situational awareness and early warning information.
NonC2 JU does not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.

1. If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority; this procedure applies to both real-time and nonrealtime data.

2. If the system filters tracks/IUs on receipt, it must establish a transmit filter that duplicates the receive filter; when the receive filter is geographically defined, the transmit filter must, where possible, be defined to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations. Any track or nonC2 IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered.
If a NonC2 JU attempts to transmit on the Surveillance NPG, it shall not transmit; exit: the NonC2 JU continues monitoring the Surveillance NPG without transmitting.

If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority; this procedure applies to both real-time and nonrealtime data. Exit: the new data need not be accepted.
If a track or nonC2 IU has an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1, it shall not be filtered. Exit: the track or nonC2 IU is not filtered.
The NonC2 JU has received situational awareness information from the Surveillance NPG, including track and Reference Point data necessary to support the platform mission.
The J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages have been monitored by the NonC2 JU for situational awareness and early warning information.
Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages have provided the NonC2 JU with situational awareness and early warning information.
The NonC2 JU has not transmitted on the Surveillance NPG.
